window.payments: annual end-window budget, except known Q3 dividend within window1; one-quarter upstream lag represented by declared/receivable/cash bridge
window.opening: 2026-09-30 reported balances plus explicit known/estimated October bridge; not audited October accounts

business.future_compensation: cash replacement of new incentive awards is already included in cash opex ratios; no free perpetual new equity grants

finance.ordinary_rollover: only outstanding ordinary principal; no unconditional reuse of repaid capacity; no net new ordinary debt

ownership.definition: weights are direct minority claims on consolidated amounts, not 100% subsidiary shares. NCI financial/debt ledgers roll independently; NCI value is full operating + own financial + own associate - own debt. Common pool is exact residual. No double minority reduction.
ownership.boundary_policy: Conditional full group recourse base, NOT a verified guarantee: negative raw NCI valued at zero only together with deficiency reassignment to common group obligation; limited-recourse alternative pairs minority floor with same-scope creditor recovery discount. These are valuation boundaries, not proof of cash default. Real pool liquidity support capped, recorded internal, no new group cash.

parent.reserve_after_threshold: continue baseline policy until separately justified; no automatic stop at can-stop threshold

securities.exercise: year-end after dividend if intrinsic midpoint exceeds adjusted strike; shares and actual exercise cash enter same ledger; bounded fixed-point convergence, never external share price

valuation.core_definition: BASE_COST_RANGE_ONLY: identical operating/funding/options base, only operating WACC endpoints. Final economic core range requires post-run assessment of three operating alternatives; no automatic pressure pooling or probability weights.
valuation.auxiliary: unlevered normal cash-like operating income capitalization at same WACC; positive growth reinvestment on productive capital+NWC+Cmin; no group interest/NCI deducted before EV
